runs.answer:
It is common to feel like you have to pee all the time when you have a stent in place. Here are some things that may help:

**Tamsulosin**: Continue taking your tamsulosin 0.4 mg at bedtime as prescribed. It helps relax the ureter and can ease discomfort associated with the stent [51, 52].
